MECHANISM. The Z/O suffix on a colour surface format names what the RASTER STORES into the pad bits; the texture unit then reads the stored bytes plainly. psh.c stamps that constant as fragColor.a and writes the combiner's real alpha to source output index 1; vk/draw.c gives the COLOUR blend SRC1_ALPHA / ONE_MINUS_SRC1_ALPHA in place of the guest's SRC_ALPHA and forces the ALPHA blend to ONE/ZERO/ADD; vk/texture.c withdraws #48's read-side swizzle behind the same device condition; instance.c enables dualSrcBlend only where the feature bit AND maxFragmentDualSrcAttachments both allow it, and refuses to enable rather than failing to start.

WHAT CHANGED IN THE CODE SINCE THE WITHDRAWN PAIR, and why each could have altered a verdict:

  H1/H2. The synthetic blend field was at bits 16..17, overlapping NV_PGRAPH_BLEND_LOGICOP_ENABLE. init_pipeline_key() strips that bit, so PSH_PAD_ALPHA_ZERO was erased and a _Z pad format was indistinguishable from a no-pad format in the pipeline key -- the exact aliasing the field exists to prevent. On the eds3 path key->regs[0] is zeroed entirely so the Adreno part would not have shown it, which is why an arm on this fleet could have passed every leg with the bug live. The field is now at bits 18..19 with three build asserts checked against the register macros, and is written unconditionally so it can never carry guest bits.

  H3. create_pipeline() early-returned before init_pipeline_key() on a colour-format-only change, because color_format is not a register and SET_SURFACE_FORMAT bumped counters only on the zeta arm. pgraph.c now bumps pipeline_state_gen on the colour arm. Blend surface and Surface format are exactly the suites that change only that register, so this could have produced arm-1's measured defect on the static path while the shader stamped correctly.

First the decomposition: 49,152 differing px = 48 green-only at max delta 128 plus 49,104 alpha-only, DISJOINT, with R and B bit-exact. The correct byte is in our memory and fetched correctly; only the override zeroes it. The 48 green px are arm 3's pre-existing residual, which this change does not touch, so 0 is the WRONG answer and the intermediate value is the prediction.
